title: HDFC Bank Launches 'Max for Seniors' and 'Max for Her' Savings Account Variants
summary: HDFC Bank Launches 'Max for Seniors' and 'Max for Her' Savings Account Variants

items: HDFC Bank launched **'Max for Seniors'** and **'Max for Her'** savings account variants with auto-sweep and accidental death cover on debit card up to **₹3.19 crore**.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
